artboards.title: Desktop demo layout for the CEO

annotations.text:
Thesis
The unit of value is a completed action that improves an outcome, not a conversation. Everything here serves the loop: plan, decide, act, observe, repeat.

Rule
Penny explains. Planner computes. No number reaches the customer that a deterministic function did not produce first.

Rule
Only Doer can change anything, only after permission. Every action has before, after, who, when, and undo. Individualized investment advice goes to a licensed human via Advisor desk.

Why these two personas
Maya has never acted; the product must remove fear and friction. Jordan acts but does not sustain; the product must reason and stay out of the way. If the loop works for both, it generalizes.

Top row: the Penny tab
One thread, six stretches, in order. It is the main tab and the only place anything gets decided.

Bottom row: the other tabs
Overview, Plan, Actions, You. All downstream of the thread. None of them proposes anything.

The team, from the user's side
Penny is the coach you talk to. Reader, Analyst, Planner, Guardian, Doer, Watcher, and Advisor desk are the specialists she calls. Their name is on every step, like a subagent in Claude Code. Only Doer can act, only after you allow it.
